Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed page). Region EU: indicators for sizes typical of average EU locations. Loaded only heat-relevant technology tables: solar thermal electricity (T10), geothermal (T15-17), biomass and waste power (T45-49), CHP (T51-54), fuel cells (T55-57), thermal storage for CSP (T66) and heat pumps (T71-75), each as separate processes for 2013, 2020, 2030 and 2050 (2040 not loaded; years printed n/a or - have no process). Not loaded: wind, PV, hydro, ocean, condensing fossil and nuclear power, CCS plants, grid, electricity storage, biomass co-firing, water use and staffing rows. Traps: all costs EUR 2013 (stated); CAPEX is overnight, per kWe for power and CHP plants (not per kW heat) and per kWth for heat pumps; FOM is printed as % of CAPEX ref per year so opex-fixed is DERIVED (formula in each row); COP is loaded as efficiency x100; "Max. capacity factor" is an availability by the report definition; CAPEX low/high are in value-min/value-max beside the reference; thermal-plant efficiency is LHV per the report statement but table labels do not say so; Tables 52-54 print "Efficiency @peak thermal load" without saying electrical or thermal; hydrogen electrolysers are not in this edition.
